rationale: Rank-1 final (pic50_on_rescore 8.7048, valid_connected true, pb_fast_pass true, energy converged) compared against all 999 other finals (960 valid-rest) using terminal_world_A coordinates. Only R00 (slots 4,15), R13 (slots 8,11,14) and R19 (slot 22) have nonempty registered support; all other regions have empty support and undefined moments, so no hypothesis is filed there. R00 shows a modest positive occupancy shift (soft_mass +3.58e-4, percentile 0.762) with near-null coordinate offsets (|z|<=0.57) and a small cov_xz shift (+0.0108, percentile 0.764); R19 shows the largest occupancy contrast (soft_mass +2.82e-4, z=0.810, percentile 0.832) but zero dispersion on all six covariance entries because its support is a single atom. R13 is essentially at the rest mean (soft_mass z=-0.048) with mildly reduced y/z dispersion (cov_yy z=-0.897, cov_zz z=-0.506). These are descriptive one-to-rest contrasts, not causal or calibrated native-success claims; clones and shared roots make the rest dependent, and covariance entries are axis dispersions, not planarity, rigidity or binding energy.
